title: supply-chain-model: model, tests and paper source for 'Supply restrictions: where employment falls, and why'
description: Python model and an independent JavaScript port of a production-chain model of supply restrictions, with tests that reproduce every figure printed in the working note Supply restrictions: where employment falls, and why (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23019960; all versions 10.5281/zenodo.22836880). The Python reproduces all 61 printed figures; the JavaScript port reproduces 41 of them with its own linear solver; the two agree to about 1e-15 over 4,000 randomly generated chains. The repository also holds the LaTeX source of the paper and a fact-check of every external claim.
